questions.question: What does the MCP Tool Suite do?
questions.reference: The MCP Tool Suite is a multi-tool MCP server platform that exposes many AI-callable tools over the Model Context Protocol, so a single server can be connected to multiple clients.
reference_contexts: A multi-tool MCP server platform: one remote server that exposes many AI-callable tools over the Model Context Protocol.

questions.question: Which auth modes are supported?
reference_contexts: Auth is selected with AUTH_MODE; modes: none (default), bearer, oauth2

questions.question: Which tools are included?
questions.reference: index_document, semantic_search, document_qa, analyze_document, review_code, analyze_data, web_research, generate_report.
reference_contexts: index_document, semantic_search, document_qa, analyze_document, review_code, analyze_data, web_research, generate_report

questions.question: What providers does it use for LLMs and embeddings?
questions.reference: LLMs: groq, ollama, openai, anthropic, fake. Embeddings: ollama, openai, hashing.
reference_contexts: LLM providers: groq | ollama | openai | anthropic | fake. Embeddings: ollama | openai | hashing
